Rumors suggest Apple will adopt the "iPhone Ultra" branding for its upcoming foldable model, and Mark Gurman says this is indeed a name widely used within the company.

Rumors suggest Apple internally uses "iPhone Ultra" as the name for its foldable phone

Apple will unveil its highly anticipated foldable iPhone at its September event next month.

Since rumors about the first foldable iPhone began to surface, this model has generally been referred to as the "iPhone Fold".

But earlier this year, some leakers began claiming that "iPhone Ultra" would be the official name of the product.

Although this is by no means a confirmation of Apple's plans, well-informed leaker Mark Gurman posted on X today, saying that "everyone internally calls it Ultra".

Just because "Ultra" is the internal name commonly used by many Apple employees does not mean it is the final branding.

Apple is a highly secretive company, to the extent that many employees often know nothing about unannounced products unless they are directly involved in the relevant work.

"iPhone Ultra" may simply be used internally because external sources have been referring to the foldable phone that way. But the actual product name is likely known only to core members of Apple's marketing team and other insiders.

Do you think iPhone Ultra will be the official name of this foldable phone? What name is more likely? Let us know in the comments.
